Optional delegated sign-in through Matrix Authentication Service, which brings QR code device linking to Element.

## ✨ Added

- **Matrix Authentication Service (MAS) in the image,** off by default. Switched on, it takes over sign-in and Element can link a new device by QR code (MSC4108). Switched off, the rendered Synapse config is exactly what it was without it.
- **What delegation needs:** a second, empty PostgreSQL database, a second proxy host on port 8090 with HTTPS, and one rule that sends `/_matrix/client/*/{login,logout,refresh}` to 8090. Section 11 of the README walks through it.
- **New template fields** under Advanced: `AUTH_ENABLED`, `AUTH_PUBLIC_BASE`, `AUTH_POSTGRES_DB`, `_HOST`, `_USER` and `_PASSWORD`, `AUTH_ALLOW_REGISTRATION`, `AUTH_QR_LOGIN`, `AUTH_MIGRATE`, and port 8090.
- **Account migration into MAS.** With `AUTH_MIGRATE=true` the container runs a pre-flight check, a dry run and the migration during startup, before Synapse comes up, and stops with the reason if anything fails. Sessions, devices and passwords survive, and it never runs twice.
- **Read this before you switch delegation on.** Sign-in moves to the browser, email login stops, password and account changes move to the MAS web page, `ADMIN_USER` no longer applies (the log prints the `mas-cli` commands instead) and encrypted bridges break. Back up the database first, because once someone has signed in only a restore undoes it.

## 🎨 Design

- The banner wordmark and claim were refitted to the larger logo.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The admin UI is Ketesa,** the maintained fork of Synapse-Admin, at the same address (`:8080/admin/`). It is the only one that understands a homeserver with delegated auth.
- **Component versions live only in the Dockerfile.** The build workflow had overridden them, so the image shipped an older Element Web than the Dockerfile named and Renovate's bumps changed nothing. Element Web is at v1.12.25 now.
- CI checks that MAS stays inert when switched off, boots the delegated path and checks what Element needs for QR login, and migrates a real account and signs in with its old password.
- The MAS binary is run once per platform during the build, so a broken arm64 binary fails the build instead of reaching you.
- The image label and the Docker Hub page now say `AGPL-3.0-only`, matching `LICENSE`.
- The README explains the case where QR linking fails because `public_baseurl` does not match the address clients use, and the manual migration steps name both Synapse config files.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Failed startup checks stop the container.** s6-overlay carried on after a failed init script, so a missing `SERVER_NAME` or a broken config gave a running but wrong homeserver. It now stops with the reason in the log.
